input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for flip annotation processor. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to interact with flip description functionality, so that I can accomplish my flip description-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with flip advice functionality, so that I can accomplish my flip advice-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with test client functionality, so that I can accomplish my test client-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with test client other functionality, so that I can accomplish my test client other-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use flip annotation processor capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
